meta.description: Your Veltskins account: purchases, Steam delivery, marked lots and your details.

overview.title: Hello, {name}
overview.welcomeBody: Your billing address is stored for checkout, and a welcome email is on its way. Connecting Steam comes next.
overview.noOrdersBody: When you buy a lot, you can follow its Steam delivery here.

steam.title: Trade URL
steam.body: The Steam account connected, and its trade URL

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Your name, email, telephone, date of birth and password

saved.title: Marked lots
saved.body: Lots you marked to come back to

orders.title: My purchases
orders.body: Each purchase, with where its delivery stands

orders.title: My purchases
orders.caption: Your orders, newest first
orders.emptyBody: Buy a skin and this is where you watch it travel to Steam.

order.title: Purchase {number}
order.paymentMethod: Settled by card on the provider's secure page.
order.helpBody: Anything at all — a trade offer, a refund, something else entirely. We fill the order number in on your behalf.
order.helpAction: Write to us about this purchase
order.notFoundBody: No such order sits under this account. Another account may well have placed it.
order.waiver: You asked for immediate delivery on {date} and acknowledged that the right to cancel ends once delivery begins.
order.liveUpdates: Expect this page to move while your lots are in transit.

saved.title: Marked lots
saved.lead: Lots you've marked to come back to. Marking doesn't reserve a lot or hold its price.
saved.emptyBody: Choose Mark on any lot to keep it here.

addresses.title: Billing addresses
addresses.lead: Whichever address is default arrives at checkout as your billing address. Changing it order by order remains possible.
addresses.saveFailed: We couldn't save this. Please try again.
addresses.removeBody: {address} will be removed from your address book. Orders already placed hold on to the address they used.
addresses.emptyBody: Store an address and checkout fills itself in.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailHint: Changing the email on an account is something we do for you — just ask.
profile.saveFailed: We couldn't save this. Please try again.
profile.emailAdd: Give us an email address and confirmations and invoices can reach you.

steam.title: Trade URL
steam.lead: Every skin you buy leaves as a trade offer to this URL. The URL has to come from the Steam account connected here.
steam.linkLead: Connect whichever Steam account your lots should arrive in. Signing in happens on Steam's own page, and what reaches us is your Steam ID and public profile.
steam.linkNote: Neither your Steam password nor a Steam Guard code is ever visible to us.
steam.tradeSaved: Stored, and verified against your Steam account
steam.tradeHint: Find it in Steam under Inventory, Trade Offers, <link>Who can send me Trade Offers?</link>

flags.taken: Another account here has already claimed that Steam account. Use it to sign in, or come to us.
flags.other: A different Steam account is already connected to yours. Ask us and we will change it.

errors.invalid: That is not the shape of a Steam trade URL. Take the whole link, the one beginning https://steamcommunity.com/tradeoffer/new/
errors.otherAccount: That trade URL comes from another Steam account. It needs to be the trade URL of the account you connected.
errors.generic: The trade URL did not save. Please try again.
errors.loadTitle: Your Steam details would not load
errors.load: Check the connection and have another go.

help.awaiting_payment: Delivery begins the moment your payment is confirmed.
help.paid: Your payment is confirmed. We have asked for the offer.
help.processing: Your offer is being made ready.
help.sent: Take the offer in Steam before it lapses. Satisfy yourself that it carries this lot and nothing more.
help.finished: The lot has landed in your Steam inventory. Steam may hold it under trade protection for some days yet.
help.refund_pending: The price you paid for this lot is on its way back.
help.refunded: This lot's price has been returned to you.
help.rolled_back: Steam reversed the trade. This lot is being refunded.
